other_conditions: The child must have lost either father or mother or both (orphan status)
Applicant must be a resident of Kerala state
Students from first standard to degree classes are eligible
For Above Poverty Line (APL) children, annual income must be below ₹20,000 in rural areas (Local body/Grama Panchayat)
For Above Poverty Line (APL) children, annual income must be below ₹22,375 in urban areas (Corporation/Municipality)
Children below 5 years of age are directly eligible
benefits_summary: Provides monthly financial assistance ranging from ₹300 for children below 5 years or classes I‑V up to ₹1,000 for degree or professional courses.
